description: The Microsoft.Extensions versions are the lowest the provider compiles against, not the versions it is expected to run on.
NuGet resolves the highest version of the consumer graph, so an add-in on a newer release band keeps that band.
Raising the floor forces every add-in onto the new band, and an add-in that pins an older one fails to restore with NU1605.
The test project stays on the same versions and exercises the floor the package declares.
